title: PKM Extension
description: Personal Knowledge Management extension settings for JupyterLite

startFile.title: Start File
startFile.description: Path to the markdown file to open automatically on startup (e.g., 'start.md').

showWelcome.title: Show Welcome Dialog
showWelcome.description: Show the welcome dialog on first visit.

defaultMarkdownMode.title: Default Markdown Mode
defaultMarkdownMode.description: Default mode for opening markdown files.

autoSaveDelay.title: Auto-save Delay (ms)
autoSaveDelay.description: Delay in milliseconds before auto-saving markdown files. Set to 0 to disable auto-save.

enableWikilinkCompletion.title: Enable Wikilink Completion
enableWikilinkCompletion.description: Enable auto-completion when typing [[ in markdown files.

filePathCacheTTL.title: File Path Cache TTL (ms)
filePathCacheTTL.description: Time-to-live for file path resolution cache entries in milliseconds.
